historical_reviews.deepseek: Overbroad log terms cannot attribute LCRC direction or distinguish link-layer replay from AER escalation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Improves physical safety but leaves per-slot NBIO mapping, directed traffic, counter delta and acceptance thresholds undefined.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Unlike the ECRC and Poisoned-TLP cases, LCRC is link-local and direction-sensitive; acceptance needs transmitter/receiver roles and link counters, not generic uncorrectable severity evidence.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Directional link faults require an isolated traffic path, pre/post counters and a no-persistent-degradation oracle.

original_test_intent: Verify correctable LCRC fault handling in both transmit and receive directions for every required PCIe slot, proving the intended link/counter response, bounded packet impact and stable NIC/link operation after each stimulus.
original_method: Map each physical NIC/slot to socket, die, NBIO, core and port; prove errortype 0/1 direction semantics; identify local transmitter/receiver and run isolated bidirectional traffic; capture link speed/width, AER and PCIe/NIC error counters; inject TX once and RX once separately; correlate the expected directional counter/status delta without fatal escalation; verify traffic integrity and no retrain/degradation; restore BIOS/HDT/AER state.
manual_activity: The FAE installs/maps the NIC, approves errortype direction and the isolated traffic path, performs one TX and one RX injection under OOB supervision and owns link/driver recovery and configuration restoration.
required_inputs: Physical slot/NIC serial/FW/driver/BDF to socket/die/NBIO/core/port map for every target
AMD tool/spec proof that errortype 0 and 1 represent LCRC TX and RX and identify the observing side
Isolated bidirectional traffic endpoints, packet/checksum/loss oracle and management dependencies
Exact PCIe/NIC/AER status and directional counter expected before/after each injection
Decoded 7EF6030 relevance plus masks, DPC and SyncFlood policy for a correctable LCRC case
Supported OS, timeout, acceptable replay/retrain delta, aborts, OOB recovery and restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated NIC/link with OOB management independent of tested traffic and no production workload
Power/ESD-safe NIC handling and live tuple verification; never reuse 0:0:1/core3/port0 blindly
Run controlled traffic to prove direction and baseline all counters before a single injection
Abort on wrong port/counter, link loss, speed/width downgrade, excessive packet loss, driver reset or fatal/DPC/SyncFlood escalation
No automatic retry; preserve evidence and restore/diff BIOS/HDT/AER/SyncFlood and NIC state
agent_execution_scope: Validate tool direction semantics, topology, traffic isolation, counters and correctable recovery oracle
Collect read-only link/AER/NIC counters, traffic integrity, OS/BMC and post-health evidence
Do not install NIC, choose tuple/traffic/threshold, change BIOS/HDT, inject/retrain/reset/retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve per-slot NBIO/core/port mapping and TX/RX semantics
Approve traffic, counters and correctable thresholds
Supervise separate TX and RX stimuli and recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A grep mixing LCRC with ECRC, poison and fatal cannot prove which directional LCRC path fired or whether replay preserved traffic.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After live tuple and flag validation, inject TX and RX separately under isolated bidirectional traffic and correlate direction-specific link/AER/NIC counter deltas, packets and post-link state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Tuple 0:0:1/core3/port0, errortype 0/1, correctable Criteria, severity/SyncFlood settings, slot 1~N and 30/60-minute values remain preserved but gated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run separate topology-mapped TX and RX LCRC injections during disposable traffic, proving the correct directional counter/status delta and clean replay/recovery without link degradation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds transmitter/receiver roles, traffic integrity, counter baselines, correctable thresholds, register-policy review and explicit rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Tool PASS or generic dmesg text cannot distinguish TX from RX or prove link-layer correction preserved traffic.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The injection may drop packets, retrain or downgrade the link, reset the NIC/driver or affect the management network.

project_override_considerations: If hardware exposes no attributable directional LCRC counter, use an owner-approved link analyzer or tool transcript oracle; do not replace missing direction evidence with generic AER text. ECC RDIMM relevance must be justified or treated as copied source text.
expected_evidence: Tool/spec direction mapping plus decoded AER/severity policy and baseline counters
Isolated traffic endpoint, direction, packet/checksum baseline
Separate TX and RX transcripts with attributable counter/status deltas
Packet outcome, no fatal escalation and restored speed/width/link/driver health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Slot 1~N is reduced to one fixed NBIO/core/port tuple; errortype 0/1 direction semantics are not cited; ECC RDIMM is unexplained; generic logs mix unrelated ECRC/poison/fatal classes; no directed traffic or counter oracle exists. Correctable Criteria coexist with undecoded uncorrectable severity/SyncFlood settings, timeout is undefined and RHEL 2022 ambiguous.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The TX/RX LCRC intent is clear enough for static review. Execution remains gated until engineering supplies directional semantics, topology and observable counters.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 61 Wistron-System RAS-00781-V002: provide PCIe slot/NIC-to-socket/die/NBIO/core/port coverage and vendor proof errortype 0/1 mean LCRC TX/RX with observing-side semantics; justify ECC RDIMM; define isolated bidirectional traffic, direction-specific link/AER/NIC counters and packet/replay/retrain thresholds; approve 7EF6030/masks/DPC/SyncFlood relevance, supported OS, timeout, aborts, OOB recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Turns an overbroad generic-log check into a directional link-layer test with attributable counters and traffic-integrity evidence, while gating the single hardcoded port tuple.
independent_technical_reasoning: An LCRC fault is detected by the receiving link partner and normally drives replay, so the injection-side label alone does not prove where evidence should appear. TX and RX coverage requires traffic in the corresponding direction plus counters tied to the mapped port. An OS may not emit a generic AER message for every corrected link replay, making link/NIC counters and packet integrity more reliable than a broad log grep.
